source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
You should have just received the first half of the edits. Thank you so much for allowing me the chance to work with your novel. It’s an ambitious and very relevant book. I’ll get into the novel and overview more in the second part of my edits, which will include my 15-20 page editorial letter and a video chat we’ll schedule after you get the letter.

My suggestion is to move through the manuscript and comments not making any changes or edits and just taking the notes in. Then sit with them for a bit thinking about how you want to potentially approach the edits. All my comments are from a perspective of focusing on how to help you meet your intention for the novel and help readers connect with the story and its themes. I would also suggest waiting till getting the editorial letter to make any big changes. The editorial letter will get into more specifics, provide detailed overview of the novel’s elements, break down the movement of the piece, and give more examples and resources to help you as you do your revisions.

Another thing I like to tell authors as they dive into comments along the draft is that there are going to be a lot of sections or moments where I ask questions that are not meant to be answered to me but should be clarified on the page to limit reader confusion and keep the prose and story flowing. All the comments are meant to give you insight into where the story is causing confusion or needs additional work. That all being said, you may do as you like and start editing today! I get that urge. And ultimately this is your novel and I am here to help you.

I also wanted to specify that my comments should not be used to train AI or be fed into an LLM or AI writer to help revise stories or come up with new ones.

If there are specific things you want me to elaborate on or provide additional insight on in the editorial letter, let me know! I’ll be sure to include them. I’ll get into more of your questions and things to pay attention in my letter as well!

Thanks! Talk soon.

prohibited_uses: providing the comments to an LLM or AI writer to revise stories
providing the comments to an LLM or AI writer to create new stories
